findings.problem: The same nontrivial construction is rebuilt in two proofs. It builds the P.Ring-algebra map `rho : q.ResidueField →ₐ m.ResidueField` with its `commutes'` proof. It proves `rho` bijective via `RingHom.SurjectiveOnStalks.residueFieldMap_bijective` and `surjectiveOnStalks_of_surjective`, and wraps it as `erho` and `residueChange`. It then builds `localE`, the composite of `cotangentSpaceEquivTensorKaehlerOfResidueEquiv`, `tensorKaehlerEquivOfFormallyEtale.symm.baseChange` and `cancelBaseChange`. Finally it proves `hlocalE`, which sends the cotangent class of `x` to `1 ⊗ D x`. The sibling theorem `linearIndependent_localizedCotangentComplex_of_localCotangent` repeats this almost verbatim, including a private copy of `conormalEquiv_apply`. Both declare `rho`, `hrho`, `erho`, `residueChange`, `localE` and the same `dsimp`/`rw` chain for `hlocalE`. The 8-line `rw` proof of `hlocalE` and the `commutes'` argument must be kept in sync by hand in two files.
findings.proposed_change:
Factor the shared setup into one reusable declaration, placed in this file or an earlier one so that LocalizedCotangentComplex.lean can use it. Sketch of a helper:
`noncomputable def residueFieldEquivOfComap (P : Algebra.Presentation K S (Fin n) (Fin r)) (m : Ideal S) [m.IsMaximal] (q : Ideal P.toExtension.Ring) [q.IsMaximal] (hq : q = m.comap (algebraMap P.toExtension.Ring S)) : q.ResidueField ≃ₐ[P.toExtension.Ring] m.ResidueField`. Its proof is the current `rhoRing`/`rho`/`hrho`/`ofBijective` block.
A second helper would be `localCotangentEquivTensor (e : q.ResidueField ≃ₐ[K] K) : IsLocalRing.CotangentSpace (Localization.AtPrime q) ≃ₗ[q.ResidueField] q.ResidueField ⊗[P.toExtension.Ring] Ω[P.toExtension.Ring⁄K]`. This is the current `localE`, which needs only `e`.
A companion lemma `localCotangentEquivTensor_toCotangent (x) (hx : x ∈ q) : localCotangentEquivTensor e (toCotangent ⟨algebraMap _ _ x, _⟩) = 1 ⊗ₜ D K _ x` would hold the current `hlocalE` proof, including `conormalEquiv_apply`.
This target proof would then take `erho := residueFieldEquivOfComap P m q hq` and `localE := localCotangentEquivTensor ((erho.restrictScalars K).trans m.residueFieldAlgEquivOfIsAlgClosed)`, and use the companion lemma in place of `hlocalE`. The sibling proof would do the same with `hq := rfl`, and could also reuse `residueChange` built from `erho`. The private `conormalEquiv_apply` could be deleted from both files.
findings.benefit: The two multi-step constructions and the `hlocalE` computation would live once. Both long proofs would shrink noticeably, and the main theorems would show only their distinct reasoning: cotangent-complex comparison and linear-independence transport. A future change to the residue-field comparison or the Kähler identification would then be made once instead of in two places.

findings.problem: The argument upgrades `LinearIndependent K v` to `LinearIndependent F v` when the field F is K-isomorphic to K. It proves surjectivity of `algebraMap K F` from a K-algebra equivalence `e : F ≃ₐ[K] K`, then applies `map_of_surjective_injectiveₛ` with `AddMonoidHom.id`. It supplies an ad hoc `algebraMap_smul` compatibility proof, then uses `change ... at hmap` and `simpa only [AddMonoidHom.id_apply]` to clean up. The sibling proof repeats this exactly, with `m.ResidueField` in place of `q.ResidueField`: `hKsurj`, the `map_of_surjective_injectiveₛ` call with the same `fun k z ↦ (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul ..).symm`, and the same `change`/`simpa` cleanup. The only differences are the field and the module. The fiddly elaboration-driven steps (`AddMonoidHom.id _`, `change ... at hmap`) are tedious to maintain and obscure the one-line mathematical idea: when `K → F` is an isomorphism, K-independence equals F-independence.
findings.proposed_change:
Add a general lemma, for example
`lemma LinearIndependent.of_algEquiv_base {K F M ι} [Field K] [Field F] [Algebra K F] [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M] [Module F M] [IsScalarTower K F M] (e : F ≃ₐ[K] K) {v : ι → M} (h : LinearIndependent K v) : LinearIndependent F v`.
Proof sketch: `Function.Surjective (algebraMap K F)` follows from `e`, as in the current `hKsurj`. Apply `h.map_of_surjective_injectiveₛ (algebraMap K F) (AddMonoidHom.id M) hsurj Function.injective_id (fun k x => (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul F k x).symm)` and finish with `simpa`, with the `change` hidden inside the lemma. The target proof then becomes `have hliTensor := hliTensorK.of_algEquiv_base e`. The sibling proof becomes `hliComplexK.of_algEquiv_base (m.residueFieldAlgEquivOfIsAlgClosed (K := K))`, with `e` taken as `m.residueFieldAlgEquivOfIsAlgClosed`. Both instantiations assume `IsScalarTower K F M`, which already holds here: `q.ResidueField ⊗[P.Ring] Ω` and `m.ResidueField ⊗[Localization.AtPrime m] E.CotangentSpace` are tensor modules over the residue field. If the non-derived instance is awkward, state the lemma with `algebraMap K F` surjective and `IsScalarTower`.
findings.benefit: This removes about 19 lines of elaboration-sensitive code from this proof and a matching block from the sibling. Each use shrinks to a one-line call. The lemma gives the mathematical fact a name and a single proof. It could also be reused by any later file that transports independence from an algebraically closed base field to a residue field.
